_comment: Home feed fixture served by scripts/mock-backend.mjs at GET /wp-json/3ho-solstice/v1/home. `events` adds catalog-only fields (summary, cover, registrationUrl) per slug — a slug with no bundle fixture (the built-in Summer Solstice) is listed from here alone. `posts` are staff-authored posts: eventSlug scopes one to an event, omit it for everyone. Bodies use the info-page grammar (blank line = paragraph, ∙ = bullet). `landings` are designed promo pages (docs/LANDINGS.md): eventSlug scopes one to an event's home, omit it (or set pinned) for the app Home's Featured section. Re-read on every request — edit and reload.

summer-solstice-2026.name: Summer Solstice Sadhana 2026
summer-solstice-2026.summary: Chardi Kala · A Celebration of Joy. Nine days of Sadhana, White Tantric Yoga® and community in the high desert.

wsol26.summary: Seven days by the lake in Florida: White Tantric Yoga® Dec 17–19, the Solstice on Dec 20, and a program for the whole family.

posts.title: Winter Solstice 2026 registration is open
posts.body:
Join us December 15–21 at Retreats By The Lake in Lake Wales, Florida. Early registration is open now.

∙ White Tantric Yoga® on December 17, 18 and 19
∙ The Solstice itself on December 20
∙ Family and youth program at the Children's Camp

Register early to reserve your spot and the housing option you prefer.

posts.title: Getting to Lake Wales
posts.body:
The nearest airports are Orlando (MCO, about 75 minutes) and Tampa (TPA, about 90 minutes). A shuttle will run from Orlando on December 15 and back on December 21.

∙ Book your shuttle seat when you register
∙ Carpool board opens in November
∙ Parking on site is free

posts.title: Serve at Solstice: seva teams are forming
posts.body:
Every Solstice runs on seva. Kitchen, site crew, children's camp and welcome desk teams are looking for volunteers for the winter event.

Seva shifts come with a discount on registration and a very good breakfast.

posts.title: Thank you, Summer Solstice 2026
posts.body: Photos and recordings from Ram Das Puri are being gathered. We will share them here as they are ready.

posts.title: Save the date: Summer Solstice 2027
posts.body: Summer Solstice Sadhana returns to Ram Das Puri in June 2027. Dates and registration will be announced here first.

landings.title: Gong & Sound Immersion
landings.tagline: Stay one more day by the lake: two days of gong, mantra and deep rest to seal your Solstice.
landings.summary: Dec 22-23. Save the details offline and register when you are online.
landings.location: Retreats By The Lake, Lake Wales, FL
highlights: A gentle landing after seven days of Sadhana and White Tantric Yoga®.
Gong baths, mantra and long rest — nothing to achieve.
Simple tools to keep the Solstice frequency at home.

about.title: Two days of sound and stillness
about.body:
Designed as the natural continuation of Winter Solstice: you stay at the same venue, the camp quiets down, and the gong does the work.

Meals are included from Tuesday breakfast to Wednesday lunch.

callout.title: Meals included. Lodging booked separately.
callout.body: Extend your Solstice lodging with the venue when you register.

banner.title: Member savings
banner.body: 3HO Premium members and active IKYTA members receive $30 off with a member-only code at checkout.

items.question: Is lodging included?
items.answer: No. Extend your Winter Solstice lodging with the venue, or book nearby.

items.question: Can I come without attending Winter Solstice?
items.answer: Yes. The immersion is open to everyone; Solstice attendees simply stay on.

landings.title: Level One Teacher Training 2027
landings.tagline: Become a KRI-certified Kundalini Yoga teacher with 3HO's 2027 cohort.
landings.summary: Applications open now. Hybrid: online modules and an in-person week in Espanola.

hero.alt: Students practicing in the morning light

highlights: 220 hours over nine months, with a mentor group.
One in-person week at the Hacienda in June.
IKYTA membership included for the first year.

about.title: A year to become a teacher
about.body: The Level One program covers the foundations of Kundalini Yoga as taught by Yogi Bhajan®: kriya, meditation, mantra, yogic philosophy and the art of teaching.

items.question: Do I need experience?
items.answer: A regular practice helps, but the training is open to sincere beginners.

items.question: Is there a payment plan?
items.answer: Yes. Monthly installments are available at checkout.
